result: BM25 conditional edge-weight dominance (0.988 raw -> 0.512 normalized)
diagnostic: Conditional ranker weight share, raw vs. normalized
interpretation: Native score scale, not evidential strength, drove the raw-margin graph
practical_implication: Normalize per query, per ranker before combining score margins; treat raw constructions as a labeled ablation only

result: Score coverage and missing-score abstention (MiniLM 44-71% vs. BM25/TF-IDF 75-100%)
diagnostic: Per-ranker pairwise eligibility and missing-score abstention fraction
interpretation: Lower coverage is a representational limitation, not evidence of lower disagreement
practical_implication: Report per-ranker coverage alongside every dependence statistic; abstain rather than impute on missing scores

result: Raw-vs-normalized removed-edge overlap and cross-protocol sign flips (30% of cells)
diagnostic: Removed-edge Jaccard overlap; sign-flip rate across headline protocols
interpretation: Graph structure is more construction-sensitive than the retrieval-metric conclusion
practical_implication: Report structure under at least two independently-defined threshold protocols

result: Mutual-pair prevalence and vote-configuration attribution (single-vs-single 66.5-91.1% vs. lexical-bloc 3.8-26.8%)
interpretation: The hypothesized lexical-bloc mechanism is not the dominant configuration
practical_implication: Report mutual-pair attribution rather than a single aggregate rate

result: Mutual pairs vs. residual longer-cycle cyclicity
interpretation: Most apparent cyclicity is direct contradiction, not longer-cycle nontransitivity
practical_implication: Report both rates separately; never one pooled cyclicity number

result: Greedy-vs-exact repair objective gap (684/684 exact solves proven optimal)
diagnostic: Removed weight, edge-set overlap, solver optimality status
interpretation: Repair activity is not automatically near the optimal achievable reduction
practical_implication: Run an exact solve at least once per graph-size regime as a validation check

diagnostic: Holm-corrected paired nDCG delta under exact repair
interpretation: A provably optimal graph-internal objective need not improve the retrieval metric
practical_implication: Never infer retrieval benefit from repair activity alone; require a paired corrected test

result: Top-k membership change under P>k (10.6% vs. 0% at P=k)
diagnostic: Top-k membership change rate by pool/cutoff cell
interpretation: P=k suppresses visibility of a real top-k membership effect
practical_implication: Evaluate genuine P>k prefixes, not only P=k, when membership matters

diagnostic: Pairwise Kendall's tau_b, directional agreement, top-k overlap
interpretation: Rankers are dependent but not redundant
practical_implication: Measure ranker dependence directly rather than assuming it

result: Pre-pool vs. post-pool normalization order (near-identical structure)
diagnostic: Structural statistics and Holm-tested retrieval deltas under both orders
interpretation: Normalization order is not a material confound at the tested pool sizes
practical_implication: Report normalization order explicitly even where the effect is small

result: Candidate-pool-policy robustness (Jaccard 0.40-0.64 across four pools; 0 Holm-significant)
diagnostic: Pool-membership and removed-edge Jaccard across independently-defined pools
interpretation: Graph composition is pool-sensitive even where the retrieval conclusion is not
practical_implication: Name the pooling policy explicitly and test at least one alternative

diagnostic: Parser-default rate; provider-level position-bias binomial test

practical_implication: Audit parser defaults and prompt-order sensitivity before trusting any LLM-derived edge
